noah: Form: https://forms.example/office-shootout-picks - pay @noah on Venmo with note "shootout". Coin flip tiebreaker approved.

leo: Claim in. And yes to empanadas. @tia you're the hero. Also someone bring plates because the dishwasher is unpredictable.
